title: 第九章 扫货！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你知道我电话？”

“在泉城，我想知道的，就会知道。”

叶凡心中一凝，点头下车。

一回家，叶凡就盘坐，运转望气术吸收灵气。

十分钟后，电话铃声响起。

叶凡醒过来，看到是陌生本地号，将其接通。

“抱歉，刚才出手，消耗了我很多力量，所以我没空说话，但现在我已恢复一些，可以说了。”

“你哪需要道歉，是我要谢你才对。”

“嗯，我自我介绍一下，我叫王虎，是纯阳先生徒弟，我救你，是师父的意思。”

“纯阳先生？就是那个我在公园遇到的吕纯阳？”

“对，是他，而今天对付你的人，是杨家杨旭，他派人抓你，是想挖你的眼，不过你别担心，以后他不敢在对付你了，因为我会搞定他。”

叶凡眼中划过暴怒！

杨旭竟要他变瞎子！

深呼吸几口气，片刻，叶凡恢复平静，“多谢你了，不知我要怎么报答你？”

“你只需要在关键时刻接电话，我师父会联系你，当然你放心，我师父不是那种挟恩图报的人，更不会做强人所难的事。”

“好，请你转告纯阳先生，就说但有吩咐，只要在我能力范围，我义不容辞！”

王虎嗯了声，挂断电话。

“纯阳先生…嗯，看来这个化劲高手确实对我没恶意，所以我现在不需要考虑他，现在关键是杨旭！”

叶凡眼中涌现杀意，“你妈的杨旭，我明明没得罪过你，可就因为陈若彤，你就要挖我的眼，你他妈真当我好欺负了！”

“你等着，等我休息好了，我立刻找你算账！”

心中怒骂，叶凡盘坐，运转望气术修炼。

同一时间，泉城一处豪华别墅，杨旭躺在床上，享受着两位美女按摩。

手机铃声响起。

杨旭看见是蝎子来电，直接接通。

“蝎子，事办完了？”

“我是王虎，蝎子废了，他那几个兄弟也各断了一只手，现在都在医院。”

"Do you know my phone number?"

"In Quancheng, I will know whatever I want to know."

Ye Fan's heart condensed, and he nodded and got out of the car.

As soon as he returned home, Ye Fan sat cross-legged and used the qi-gazing technique to absorb the spiritual energy.

Ten minutes later, the phone rang.

Ye Fan woke up and saw that it was an unfamiliar local number and connected it.

"Sorry, the attack just now consumed a lot of my strength, so I didn't have time to speak, but now I have recovered a little and can speak."

"You don't need to apologize, it's me who wants to thank you."

"Well, let me introduce myself. My name is Wang Hu, and I am Mr. Chunyang's apprentice. I save you because of the master's wishes."

"Mr. Chunyang? Is this the Lu Chunyang I met in the park?"

"Yes, it's him, and the person who dealt with you today is Yang Xu of the Yang family. He sent people to arrest you because he wanted to gouge your eyes out. But don't worry, he won't dare to deal with you in the future, because I will deal with him."

Anger flashed in Ye Fan's eyes!

Yang Xu actually wanted him to become blind!

After taking a few deep breaths, Ye Fan regained his composure and said, "Thank you very much. I wonder how I can repay you?"

"You only need to answer the phone at the critical moment, and my master will contact you. Of course, you can rest assured that my master is not the kind of person who wants to repay favors, let alone do things that force others to do something difficult."

"Okay, please tell Mr. Chunyang that if you have instructions, as long as it is within my capabilities, I will do my duty!"

Wang Hu hummed and hung up the phone.

"Mr. Chunyang... Well, it seems that this master of energy transformation does not have any ill intentions towards me, so I don't need to consider him now. The key now is Yang Xu!"

Ye Fan had murderous intent in his eyes, "Damn it, Yang Xu, I've obviously never offended you, but just because of Chen Ruotong, you're going to dig out my eyes. You really think I'm easy to bully!"

"Just wait. When I get some rest, I'll settle the score with you right away!"

Cursing in his heart, Ye Fan sat cross-legged and practiced the Qi Watching Technique.

At the same time, in a luxurious villa in Quancheng, Yang Xu was lying on the bed, enjoying a massage from two beauties.

The cell phone rings.

Yang Xu saw that the call was from Xiezi and answered the call directly.

"Scorpion, are you done?"

"I am Wang Hu. Xie Zi is disabled. His brothers also lost one of their hands each and are all in the hospital now."
